newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner unit in $40 mln US steel deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner unit in $40 mln US steel deal.

text.p: Kvaerner Songer, part of international engineering and construction group Kvaerner ASA, said on Monday it had won a $40 million contract with USX US Steel Group.
The contract is to undertake a complete blast furnace reline of the number one furnace at the U.S. steel maker's Edgar Thomson works in Pittsburgh.
The furnace will be shut down next week and is scheduled for fill at the end of August, Kvaerner said in a statement.
Kvaerner Songer, part of the metals business area of the Kvaerner Group, has successfully relined a number of blast furnaces across the United States, the company said.
